components.name: Primary Button

components.html:
We Nuoto

Corsi in acqua aperti a tutti.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #262624; border-radius: 28px; overflow: hidden; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; } .ds-card-img { width: 100%; height: 260px; object-fit: cover; } .ds-card-body { padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Kobe, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 30px; margin: 0; color: #ffffff; } .ds-accent { color: #00a6b2; } .ds-card-text { font-size: 17px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.82); margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line form field on the near-black contact form.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: #ffffff; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; height: 52px; padding: 0 18px; background: #1d1d1b; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28); border-radius: 14px; font-size: 17px; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: 2px solid #00a6b2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Fluidity Disc
components.description: Signature abstract value icon: layered radial + conic gradients inside the same circular frame used for photographic value icons.
components.css: .ds-fluidity-disc { width: 220px; height: 220px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 28% 24%, #9be9ee 0, rgba(155,233,238,0) 32%), radial-gradient(circle at 74% 66%, #0b5f66 0, rgba(11,95,102,0) 46%), conic-gradient(from 40deg, #0b5f66, #00a6b2, #e6f4b0, #00a6b2, #0b5f66); }

narrative.overview:
Swimming and dance are both forms of rhythm and movement, and the system treats inclusion the same way: not a separate track bolted onto the brand, but the current everyone moves through together. The ground is a near-black charcoal stage that lets one color — Signal Teal — do all the talking; everything else is tonal (charcoal surfaces, three opacities of white) rather than additional hue. Display type is heavy and confident (Kobe, 700–900), set against body copy that stays deliberately light (Outfit, 300), so statements land with weight while explanations stay airy and easy to read at length.

The system's signature is asymmetric: hero and split photography sit in frames with one or two corners pulled into a deep organic curve while the others stay tight, echoing the brand's own "fluidità" value rather than defaulting to a uniform rounded-rectangle. UI chrome does the opposite — buttons are full pills, cards and the contact form share one consistent 28px radius — so the organic imagery and the disciplined interface read as two deliberately different vocabularies, not an inconsistency.

There are no shadows anywhere in the system. Depth comes from tonal contrast — near-black against lighter charcoal surfaces, white at three opacities, and a dark overlay dropped over the one full-bleed photographic moment (Claim) — never from elevation.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, no exceptions: Signal Teal is the only hue in the system.
Heavy display type over light body type — a deliberate weight snap, not a mismatch.
Organic, asymmetric corners on photography; disciplined pill/28px corners on UI chrome.
Flat by construction — tonal layering stands in for shadows everywhere.

rules.name: The Lone Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Teal is the only accent color in the system. A second accent hue is never introduced; new emphasis is expressed through weight, size, or the existing white opacities, not a new color.

rules.name: The Weight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Display-role type is never set below 700 weight; body-role type is never set above 400 weight. The gap between the two is the system's typographic voice.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never add a box-shadow to communicate elevation. Reach for a lighter tonal surface (Charcoal Surface) or an overlay instead.

dos: Do keep Signal Teal as the system's only accent color — new emphasis comes from weight, size, or white-opacity, not a new hue.
Do pair heavy display weight (700+) with light body weight (300); never settle on a mid-weight compromise.
Do give hero/split photography at least one deep, asymmetric corner radius — never let an image frame use four matching corners.
Do keep all buttons at full pill radius (999px), distinct from the 28px card/form radius.
donts: Don't add box-shadow anywhere; depth is tonal (Near-Black → Charcoal Surface → overlay), never elevation-based.
Don't introduce a second or third accent color; this is deliberately a one-accent system.
Don't set body copy above 400 weight — the light/bold contrast is load-bearing for the system's voice.
Don't round photography corners symmetrically; that vocabulary belongs to UI chrome (buttons, cards, form), not to imagery.
